prompt: An operations dashboard for a claims team: KPI cards for open, approved, average handling time, and SLA breaches; a daily approved vs rejected chart; claims by status; and a table of the latest claims with search.
A support overview with tickets received, resolution rate, first response time, a 30-day trend, tickets by channel, and a top-agents leaderboard.
A sales pipeline dashboard showing pipeline value by stage, win rate, average deal size, deals closing this month, and a table of stalled deals.
A month-end close tracker for finance: progress per task category, overdue tasks, owners, and a checklist table with status updates.
An invoice review queue: searchable table of supplier invoices with vendor, amount, due date, owner, and status; clicking a row opens details with approve and return actions.
A KYC verification work list for compliance analysts with risk level badges, filters by risk and status, bulk assign, and a detail panel showing documents and checks.
An IT helpdesk ticket list with priority, category, requester, SLA countdown, quick filters, and a side panel to reply and change status.
An approvals inbox for managers: list of pending expense, leave, and purchase requests on the left; the selected request with history and approve/reject with comment on the right.
An email triage view for a shared mailbox where an AI agent proposed a category and draft reply; reviewers accept, edit, or reassign each email.
A three-step system access request form: requester details, system and justification, review and submit, with validation and a confirmation.
A vendor onboarding wizard collecting company details, bank details, tax documents checklist, and contacts, with progress and save-as-draft.
A workplace incident report form with date and time, location, severity, people involved, description, and immediate actions taken.
A kanban board for merchant onboarding with columns New, Documents, Review, Approved, Rejected; cards show company, owner, and value; cards can be moved between columns.
A recruiting pipeline board with candidate cards (name, role, rating, days in stage) across Applied, Screen, Interview, Offer, Hired.
A customer record page with header, status, key facts, tabs for overview, orders, and activity timeline, and actions to email or escalate.
An order detail page showing line items with totals, shipping progress steps, payment status, and an activity log.
A notification settings page with toggles per channel and event type, quiet hours, and a save bar that appears when something changes.
A small operations app with a sidebar: Overview (KPIs and a trend), Queue (work items table with filters), and Reports (charts by team and month).
A monitor for AI agents processing a document queue: items per hour, success rate, failures by reason, a live list of recent failures with retry, and agent status cards.
A mobile-friendly field inspection checklist with pass/fail per item, notes, overall result, and a summary before submission.
